title: graphcomp 01 validity B2 s1
job:
# 01 — validity + B2 baseline, seed 1

**What this run is:** first the validity check in this environment (about 40 min: one gold-patch pass over the 115 fastapi/rich tasks, then an empty-patch pass over the ones the gold patch resolves), then the B2 baseline (all nine tools, sample prompt).

**Compared with:** every other notebook: they all read validity and the slices from this one's output.

**Tasks:** all 129, dev slice first, then the non-slice tasks, then holdout. Re-run with the previous version attached until the summary says ARM COMPLETE.

**Inputs:** competition data, `metric/gemma-4-developer-agent-wheelhouse`, model `google/gemma-4` `gemma-4-31b-it-qat-w4a16-ct` v2; for a resumed run, this notebook's previous version output. Do not attach the old CPU B1 output. GPU L4 × 4. Save Version → Save & Run All. **Run this one first.**

addendum:
## Graph tools (required in this run)
In every turn, before any other tool call, call one of `get_code_neighbors`, `search_similar_code` or `get_code_subgraph`.
Do this on every turn, even when you already know which file to read or edit.

addendum:
## Naming code in graph tools
When you call `get_code_neighbors` or `get_code_subgraph`, name each function, method or class by its fully qualified name in
the form `package.module.Class.method` (for example `rich.table.Table.add_row`), not by a bare name such as `add_row`. If you
do not know the qualified name yet, find it first (for example with `search_similar_code`, or by reading the file).
